title: Why Do Dogs Eat Grass?

It's probably not what you think.

script: Your dog is happily munching grass in the yard again, and no, it's probably not because they're sick. For decades people assumed dogs ate grass to make themselves vomit, but studies show fewer than one in four dogs actually throw up afterward. Most of the time it's simpler than that. Dogs are natural foragers, and grass adds fiber and roughage to their diet that helps digestion move along smoothly. Some dogs just genuinely like the taste and texture, especially fresh spring grass. It can also just be boredom, a way to interact with their environment when there's nothing more exciting going on. So unless it's paired with other symptoms, that grass snack is usually completely normal dog behavior.
